features.update: Representation/self-report/description/public metric/prediction repeatedly fails when collapsed into realized state. Keep as semantic law; no shared mechanism implied.

Evidence/state must retain causal/provenance/constraint binding. External work supports binding, but HP4 remains stronger on semantic applicability after owner drift: currentness evidence alone is not applicability competence.
Independent verification and unresolved-constraint retention support not-observed≠did-not-happen. Do not promote confidence or a single observer into truth.

Least privilege and preserved governance independently support authority separation. Ordivon's selection≠effect-authority and owner-scoped consequence semantics remain broader than current external evidence.
Reported score/tool completion/return/functionality repeatedly fails as a substitute for causal consequence. Preserve possible→selected→admitted→effect→observed→semantic consequence distinctions.

features.feature: Canonical History ≠ Working Set / Task State
features.update: Keep durable history separate from compact current state; compact state must preserve verified causal evidence, unresolved constraints and governance. Do not equate this with arbitrary summarization.

Adaptive operator/tool choice matters, but HP3 shows an Agent-facing topology classifier is a poor control interface. External evidence supports conditional policy from observable/task evidence, not discrete Ordivon topology labels.

Extra orchestration, defenses or search must repay token/time/complexity cost. CHILL is compatible with RF1 because it gates harness interventions by expected relative advantage rather than serially asking before every observation.

No external source in the cohort validates serial per-observation self-questioning as stopping. RF1/HP2 falsification stands. Future work should test batched/non-serial value estimation only on naturally expensive evidence universes.

features.feature: Evaluator is fallible world state, not Truth
features.update: Use hidden/independent/anchored/state-grounded evaluation where possible, while retaining that private/held-out/anchor itself is not owner truth. Evaluator repair/falsification is part of RSI.

Action-conditioned predicted state should be calibrated against realized environment transitions. Co-evolution is plausible, but model prediction never becomes consequence authority merely because accuracy improves.

features.feature: ResearchBet → Outcome → update Research Frontier Model
features.update: External RSI loops support explicit improvement bets and metaproductivity, but Ordivon's shadow prediction/error calibration for open-world problem selection remains relatively distinctive and under-tested.

Scientific impact preference can be learned, but current research agents also narrow exploration around seed literature. Do not equate high-impact taste with tractability/frontier selection. FS0 remains justified as an unresolved upstream capability.

Future research value should ask whether a change improves future improvement ability, not just current task score. AIDE² did not establish ignition; Ordivon should require a held-out improved-improver test before claiming it.

Causal/objective/provenance information matters more than similarity-only recall; pinned constraints and provenance boundaries should survive compaction. Additional memory-poisoning literature should be added in LW1.

External work strongly supports final-state verification, least privilege and evaluator integrity, but exact materialization, ambiguous delivery/replay, semantic applicability under owner drift and effect-principal separation remain less directly covered.

features.feature: Game improvement dynamics and held-out encounters
features.update: Do not claim game-agent improvement from cold-start score or fixed Genesis. Held-out encounter variants and improvement curves are independently motivated; human experiential truth still needs separate evidence.
Function and visual fidelity are partially decoupled. Preserve multi-axis evaluation; no automatic inference from build/test success to aesthetic/product consequence.
Return must be causally attributed and leakage-controlled before being treated as Agent competence. Ordivon's venue/execution/effect semantics remain necessary additional layers for live capital.
External evidence is compatible but not as direct. Keep the law: describing good research, skepticism or stopping rules in context does not prove the Agent can execute those controls.
